summary: Comprehensive testing of Nevika Cura Enhancement Features. Fixed critical backend bug (PyMongo Database truth value testing) and MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue. All 21 backend API tests pass. All frontend enhancement features verified working.

fixed.issue: PyMongo Database objects do not support truth value testing (if db: / if not db:)
fixed.fix: Changed all 'if db:' to 'if db is not None:' and 'if not db:' to 'if db is None:'

fixed.issue: MongoDB ObjectId not JSON serializable in add_family_member response
fixed.fix: Excluded _id from response: response_doc = {k: v for k, v in member_doc.items() if k != '_id'}
